content: Edge computing architecture for IIoT: Tier 1 (local optimization, ms-seconds) runs on edge gateway for real-time decisions. Tier 2 (site-level, seconds-minutes) coordinates across gateways. Tier 3 (regional/cloud, minutes-hours) for heavy analytics and model training. Data flows: sensors→edge gateway (protocol bridging, normalization, local processing)→cloud (storage, ML training, dashboards). Edge handles 90%+ of data locally, sends only aggregated/alerted data northbound. Store-and-forward buffering essential for WAN outages.
